sheets.title: A vault that begins from a file — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: A device with no vault could not reach the Import sheet at all: it lived inside an unlocked vault. The door now has a third road, Import a file, and choosing one goes straight to sealing the vault it is for — a passkey or a PIN, no account asked — after which the Import sheet opens on the file by itself. A .env file previews and merges; an OpenSesame backup is opened by its own PIN, passkey or password. The base build cannot reach screens 2 and 3, so they have no before.
